in_sanskrit.name: हरिप्रसाद
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hari (joy, happiness, pleasure) + Prasad (grace, blessing, or mercy) = Hariprasad (bestowed with the grace or blessing of Hari)

in_tamil.name: ஹரிப்ராஸாத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஹரி (Hari) + ப்ராஸாத் (Prasad) = ஹரிப்ராஸாத் (Hariprasad) (Hari's grace or blessing)

in_telugu.name: హరిప్రశాద్
in_telugu.long_meaning: హరి (Hari) + ప్రశాద్ (Prasad) = హరిప్రశాద్ (Hariprasad) (Hari's grace or blessing)

in_marathi.name: Hariprasad
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's joy, God's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hariprasad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hariprasad is a Sanskrit name that is derived from Hari, a name for Lord Vishnu, and Prasad, which means grace or joy. This name is often given to a child as a symbol of the parents' hope for God's blessings and joy in their lives.
